shortDescription: An earthquake measuring 5.3 magnitude struck Indonesia's Minahasa on Monday, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre said.EMSC earlier pegged the earthquake at a magnitude of 5.8, before downgrading it to 5.3 magnitude.The quake hit at a depth of 104 km (64.62 miles), according to EMSC.

children: An earthquake measuring 5.3 magnitude struck Indonesia's Minahasa on Monday, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre said.
EMSC earlier pegged the earthquake at a magnitude of 5.8, before downgrading it to 5.3 magnitude.
The quake hit at a depth of 104 km (64.62 miles), according to EMSC.
